flows.name: Homepage / Landing
flows.description: Main landing page for DinGaming, a Danish gaming marketplace. Features hero section, game deals, platform categories (Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo), and Customer Club benefits.

flows.name: Login Flow
flows.description: Login page with email and password fields. Features Customer Club benefits (1% cashback, daily login bonuses, Shards rewards). Post-login state captured.

flows.name: Product Browsing
flows.description: Browse products by platform categories. Homepage displays game deals organized by platform (Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch).

flows.name: Product Detail & Purchase
flows.description: Product detail page showing game information, pricing, platform availability, and purchase options. Example product: Two Point Hospital PC Steam Account.

flows.name: Search Flow
flows.description: Search functionality allows users to find games by keyword. Example search: "FIFA".
